message:
fix(capture-lifecycle r1): a still logon screen is shown; a UAC prompt is crossed on the same connection; a backend choice is the session's own

The 0.2.162 field (10-22: after the crash reboot the real logon screen sent no picture, the pre-login worker
exited 15; 10-23: a UAC prompt was not shown until a reconnect, black after it until a second one, the phone's
WGC choice kept for the PC). Contract codex_rel_0163_r1.md sections 1-4.

PS-A -- the cached frame carries the input desktop it was published under and that desktop's generation; it is
re-served only on the desktop the stream may show (the served logon desktop before login, Default after --
before, 'Default only' refused every pre-login frame). A confirmed desktop change, a detach, or content that
changed while nobody watched clears it. With nothing cached the capture is asked for a whole frame (DXGI: the
next acquire as content, else a new duplication, at most 3; WGC: a restart), bounded per episode, 1 s apart,
0.5 s grace after a (re)attach. Static refresh 1000 -> 500 ms, due before the first AU too.
PS-B -- the pre-login worker reattaches on DXGI even on the secure desktop (local mode only).
UA-1 -- one input-desktop tracker (100 ms, two agreeing looks, an unknown look is no change and never 'locked');
a WGC desktop capture is rebuilt on each confirmed change (once per change, 3 retries with backoff) with an IDR.
UA-2 -- a backend request belongs to the session (epoch) that made it; a new session starts from the host's
default (DXGI, the quarantine kept), a resume keeps it. Status answer (verifier-assigned): pong 0x100000,
message 90 (32 B), only to a 34 that sets flags bit0, after the main loop applied it (<= 250 ms, else
NotYetApplied); backend 0 = ask only; no unsolicited message (the client reader is request/response). Shared
client: QueryDesktopCaptureBackend / DesktopCaptureBackendStatus / HostAnswersDesktopBackendStatus.

Tests: new --still-screen e2e (the product receive chain to decoded frames; a test-build stand-in makes this
PC's never-still desktop a still logon screen) 30/30 x3; new host_capture_lifecycle_ua_e2e_test (the input
desktop shown as secure by the test build -- lifecycle, not real UAC pixels) 46/46 x3; regressions LK e2e lock
68 / prelogin 79 / not-prelogin 28, stats-chain gap, monitor fallback 173/173, host unit tests. Mutants (the test
build with each fix reverted): PS-A -> no picture in 4 s; PS-B -> the worker exits 'wgc requested'; UA-1 -> no
rebuild, no IDR after the edge; UA-2 -> the PC session inherits the phone's WGC.

Stacked on fix/lk-retry 8d8655e (the shared LK e2e file and CMake).

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(host 캡처 수명·backend 세션·상태 응답, capture lib DXGI 전체 프레임, shared client 상태 API) / 테스트(PS·UA e2e, 시험 빌드 전용 seam, kick 단위) / 문서(history·구현계획)
